description: Start a Google Maps rank grid (49 points, 8 miles) for a business by Google Place id, or by business name and city. Paid, drawn from a shared daily budget; when the budget is used up the result says quota_reached with the UTC reset time. For a running result, wait pollAfterSeconds, then call get_audit_report with runId. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

businessName.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

city.description: City, required with businessName when no placeId is given.

placeId.description: Google Place id, for example ChIJ....

state.description: US state, two-letter code or full name.

trade.description: Trade, for example hvac, plumbing, auto repair, marine. Optional; inferred when omitted.

name: check_local_rank
